group.passage: WASHINGTON, D.C. 2017 — Right-to-die legislation has been under debate in many states. A poll conducted by Gallup, an American analytics and advisory company, shows that 73% of U.S. adults say a doctor should be allowed to end a terminally ill patient’s life by painless means if the patient asks for it. The finding is consistent with the 69% to 70% Gallup has recorded since 2013, much higher than that before 1990. When Gallup first polled on euthanasia in 1947, fewer than four in ten favored its legalization by law. However, support rate has been changing over time. In 1973, 53% of the respondents supported it and since 1990, a range of 64% to 75% of Americans have expressed support for it. In addition, there are often differences in views on the subject depending on one’s religious and political persuasions. In a poll conducted this year, only 55% of weekly churchgoers support euthanasia, while 87% of adults who seldom attend church believe it should be allowed. Among party groups, it is less divisive. Among Democrats and Democratic-leaning independents, 81% support euthanasia, and 67% support it among Republicans and Republicans leaners. Several states have passed legislation to allow patients with terminal diseases to die on their own terms though more than 40 states have not done so. According to the Death with Dignity National Center, five states and the District of Columbia currently have “Death with dignity” statutes that “allow mentally competent adult state residents who have a terminal illness with a confirmed prognosis of having six or fewer months to live to voluntarily request and receive a prescription medication to hasten their inevitable, imminent death.” Last month, the Nevada State Senate narrowly passed legislation that would give terminally ill patients in the state the option of ending their own lives.

figures.caption: 四張折線圖，標題皆為「Advocates of Euthanasia」
figures.description: 第3題的四個選項各是一張折線圖，標題都是「Advocates of Euthanasia」，縱軸單位為「(%)」，橫軸依序標示 1947、1973、1990、2013、2017 (Year)（等距排列）。圖上沒有標出數值，下表的數值是依格線讀出的近似值。(A) 縱軸 0–80（每 20 一格）：由 1947 年略低於 40%（約 37%）一路上升，1990 年約 65%，之後緩升至 2017 年約 73%。(B) 縱軸 0–80：由 1947 年約 70% 出頭緩慢下降，1990 年約 62%，之後加速下降至 2017 年約 36%（低於 40%）。(C) 縱軸 0–100：由 1947 年約 63% 上升，1990 年約 78%，2013 年約 89%，2017 年約 93%（接近但略低於 100% 格線）。(D) 縱軸 0–60：由 1947 年 20% 緩升，1990 年約 30%，2013 年約 40%，2017 年約 50%。

options.D: The Process to Make Euthanasia Legitimate in America

questions.stem: Which of the following is closest in meaning to “imminent” in the last paragraph?
Which of the following line graphs best represents the trend of euthanasia advocacy?
According to the passage, which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.A: The Nevada State Senate rejected the legislation to allow euthanasia.
options.B: Gallup polled on the question concerning euthanasia in 1947 for the first time.
options.C: The more devoted a person is to religion, the less supportive he/she is of euthanasia.
options.D: The American’s attitude to euthanasia has shown slight difference in the past five years.
